component.name: Voice Transcriber
component.summary: Privacy-explicit Linux dictation with local speech detection

description.p: Voice Transcriber turns short spoken notes, prompts, emails, tickets, and drafts into text ready to copy or explicitly export.
Voice activity detection and the input meter run locally. Completed speech segments are sent to Groq Whisper; the application does not save raw audio or collect analytics.

screenshot.caption: A visible microphone signal, speech state, and transcript result area
A completed transcript ready to copy, clear, or export

description.p: Adds independently verifiable privacy, release, compatibility, and contribution evidence for the trusted stable release.
Adds a provider contract, visible data-boundary choice, and feature-flagged local whisper.cpp prototype.
Adds an editable dictation desk, focused push-to-talk, structured exports, and opt-in local text history.
Adds a Flatpak bundle, privacy-safe diagnostics, and an explicit first-run cloud setup.
Adds microphone selection, local signal verification, and machine-readable device diagnostics.
